[RDSC.14.4.5] **Source-metadata tier + strip.** `DocString` joins the source-metadata
tier with `DsSource` and `LineSpan`; `dsc strip` drops it. `DocString` is **independently
strippable from `DsSource`** — a `.dsc` may carry `DocString` with `DsSource` stripped (ship
the API docs without the source).
